About Pinterest:

Millions of people around the world come to our platform to find creative ideas, dream about new possibilities and plan for memories that will last a lifetime. At Pinterest, we’re on a mission to bring everyone the inspiration to create a life they love, and that starts with the people behind the product.

Discover a career where you ignite innovation for millions, transform passion into growth opportunities, celebrate each other’s unique experiences and embrace the flexibility to do your best work. Creating a career you love? It’s Possible.

At Pinterest, AI isn't just a feature, it's a powerful partner that augments our creativity and amplifies our impact, and we’re looking for candidates who are excited to be a part of that. To get a complete picture of your experience and abilities, we’ll explore your foundational skills and how you collaborate with AI.

Through our interview process, what matters most is that you can always explain your approach, showing us not just what you know, but how you think. You can read more about our AI interview philosophy and how we use AI in our recruiting process here.

Trust and Safety Quality helps ensure that enforcement decisions are accurate, consistent, and fair for Pinners. As a Sr. Project & Program Manager, Quality, you will independently own key quality programs for content moderation, including the quality operating mechanisms used to evaluate and improve BPO performance. You’ll turn complex and sometimes conflicting quality signals into clear decisions, practical recommendations, and measurable improvements.

This role calls for deep QA and Trust & Safety expertise, sound judgment, and the ability to lead work across teams without relying on direct authority. You’ll partner with Policy, Training, Vendor Management, Enforcement Operations, and Product and Engineering to strengthen quality processes, address performance gaps, and prepare for new product and policy launches.

What you’ll do:

  • Own core BPO content-safety quality processes, including sampling strategy, reporting, review guidance, and quality escalations. Identify emerging risks and determine when to resolve issues directly or bring them to the right partners.
  • Develop and improve quality measurement approaches, such as golden datasets, sampling methods, and precision/recall analysis, so results are reliable and useful for operational decisions.
  • Monitor quality metrics and related signals across workflows. Investigate changes, identify underlying causes, and distinguish meaningful performance shifts from noise or limitations in the data.
  • Translate findings into prioritized recommendations and lead feedback loops with BPO partners and internal teams. Track follow-through and assess whether interventions improve decision quality and operational performance.
  • Help shape and operationalize a scalable moderation quality strategy. Balance accuracy, consistency, efficiency, and policy intent when recommending changes to quality processes.
  • Establish quality plans for new product and policy launches, working with stakeholders to clarify standards, review methods, readiness criteria, and escalation paths before launch.
  • Partner with Trust & Safety Product and Engineering to define QA tooling needs, clarify requirements, and evaluate whether tooling changes improve quality workflows and outcomes.
  • Communicate complex or sensitive quality issues clearly to partners and leaders, align stakeholders with competing priorities, and influence action without direct reporting authority.
  • Use AI or automation where appropriate to accelerate analysis and quality work; validate outputs, apply critical judgment, and remain accountable for recommendations and decisions.

What we’re looking for:

  • Demonstrated experience in quality assurance, quality operations, or Trust & Safety, with the ability to independently own complex work and improve established processes.
  • Experience working with BPOs or other external partners to set expectations, evaluate performance, resolve quality issues, and achieve shared outcomes.
  • Strong knowledge of QA principles and methods, including quality measurement frameworks, golden datasets, sampling strategy, and precision/recall analysis.
  • Experience in Policy, Content Moderation, Content Quality, Content Safety, labeling, or a closely related domain.
  • Strong analytical judgment: able to identify patterns in incomplete or conflicting data, test assumptions, and make sound recommendations.
  • Proven ability to lead multiple concurrent initiatives, manage tradeoffs and escalations, and adapt plans as priorities change.
  • Clear communication and collaboration skills, including experience building trust and driving decisions across distributed, cross-functional teams.
  • Interest in using AI or automation to improve analysis or operations, paired with a thoughtful approach to validating accuracy and owning final outcomes.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • Minimum of 2 years of experience in quality control/assurance or Trust & Safety.

Relocation Statement:

  •  This position is not eligible for relocation assistance. Visit our PinFlex page to learn more about our working model.

In-Office Requirement Statement

  • We let the type of work you do guide the collaboration style. That means we're not always working in an office, but we continue to gather for key moments of collaboration and connection.
  • This role will need to be in the office for in-person collaboration 1-2 times every 6-months and therefore can be situated anywhere in the country.
